scope.summary: Author the arousal expression library (spec 13.23; PREQ-030): ahegao (eye-roll + tongue-out + flush hook), bitten lip, eye-roll, open-mouth O, and gasp/moan faces as layerable expression assets beyond ARKit-52 extremes, composing over ANY identity channel state including extreme face morphs, with Argus renders persisted per expression.
acceptance_criteria: Expression assets authored: ahegao (eye-roll plus tongue-out plus flush hook), bitten-lip, eye-roll, open-mouth O, and gasp/moan set - layerable expression morph combos at scan-derived-or-equivalent quality covering extremes beyond ARKit-52 (PREQ-030).
Layerability proven: expressions compose over any identity channel state, including extreme face morphs, without collapse - identity-extremes x expression matrix passes mesh-quality gates.
Each expression decomposes to ARKit plus extended units where possible, with the export story documented; flush hooks link to the MT-559 arousal controller through explicit edges.
Argus renders per expression (on at least one extreme-identity face) persist as visual evidence rows.
scope.risk_if_missed: Arousal acting - ahegao, gasp, eye-roll - is the expression content adult buyers actually use and no mainstream tool ships (PREQ-030); expressions that break on extreme identity morphs repeat the CC canned-expression failure and gut the library's value.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit face, expressions, and speech

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Integrate production oral and ocular assets, rigging, materials, close-up expression/pose, and export validation.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
